'
Tops' with Me
is the debut album by British singer
Helen Shapiro
. It was released in 1962 and was her most successful album, reaching number 2 in the
UK Albums Chart
. She was accompanied by
Martin Slavin
and his Orchestra.
The album comprised cover versions of songs which had already been hit singles for other artists
[
2
]
– "top pops" or simply "tops" in the slang of the day.
